messages.content: Now I need the Seattle hotel for Sunday, June 15 through Wednesday, June 18. Can you compare staying all three nights in one place with using the Sheraton for the first two nights?

Yes. For the confirmed travel window, the practical choices are: Sheraton Grand Seattle for Sunday and Monday only, followed by a Tuesday move; Hyatt at Olive 8 for all three nights; or a Capitol Hill hotel closer to Elliott Bay Book Company but farther from the daytime meetings. Please send the current rates, taxes, and cancellation terms you are seeing so I can compare the actual totals rather than estimate them.

Sheraton is $269 Sunday and $289 Monday, plus about 15.7% tax. It can be canceled until 6:00 p.m. two days before each night. Hyatt is $252 per night for all three nights, same tax, cancel by 11:59 p.m. three days before arrival. Silver Cloud Broadway is $239 per night, same tax, but nonrefundable.

The approximate lodging totals are $646 for two Sheraton nights, $875 for three Hyatt nights, and $830 for three Silver Cloud nights. A split stay using the Sheraton would still require a Tuesday room. If Tuesday were at Silver Cloud, the combined three-night total would be about $923, before any small rate variation or incidental fees.
How much time would the locations add? Monday and Tuesday meetings are at the Sheraton, and Wednesday finishes there at 3:30. The author event at Elliott Bay is Tuesday at 7:00.

Hyatt at Olive 8 is only a few blocks from the Sheraton, so the daytime meetings remain an easy walk. Elliott Bay Book Company is in Capitol Hill; from the Hyatt, allow roughly 10-20 minutes by car depending on traffic, or about 25-30 minutes using transit and walking. Silver Cloud Broadway is convenient for the Tuesday event, but it would mean commuting downtown for the meetings and returning to Capitol Hill after Wednesday checkout to retrieve luggage unless you stored the bag elsewhere.
Could I move from the Sheraton to Silver Cloud during the Tuesday lunch break?

It is possible, but the timing is awkward. You would need to check out before Tuesday's meetings, leave the bag with the Sheraton, collect it at lunch, travel to Silver Cloud, and either check in or leave it there before returning downtown. That could consume most of a typical lunch break. Moving after the meetings would be simpler, but it would compress the time before the 7:00 p.m. event.
Then the split does not sound worthwhile. Is there any operational reason not to take the Hyatt for all three nights?

No significant one based on this itinerary. It keeps you near the meeting site, avoids a Tuesday transfer, and lets you leave the roller at the same hotel Wednesday before the 3:30 finish. The Hyatt total is about $48 more than Silver Cloud, but it is cancellable and better aligned with all three meeting days. Before reserving, confirm the final tax-inclusive total, whether the room has a proper desk, and whether complimentary luggage storage is available after checkout.
The Hyatt says the room has a desk, and the front desk confirmed they will hold the bag Wednesday at no charge. The checkout time is noon.

That resolves the practical concerns. The Tuesday plan would be to finish the daytime meetings, walk back to the Hyatt if you need to change or collect anything, and leave around 6:20 p.m. for Elliott Bay, adjusting earlier if traffic is heavy. On Wednesday, check out before the meetings, leave the roller with the Hyatt, and retrieve it after the 3:30 p.m. finish.
Use the Hyatt, then. Prepare the reservation details, but do not say it is booked.

Prepare a three-night reservation at Hyatt at Olive 8, checking in Sunday, June 15 and checking out Wednesday, June 18, for one adult in one room. Use the quoted flexible rate of $252 per night, approximately $875 total with 15.7% tax, subject to the hotel's final checkout amount. The quoted cancellation deadline is 11:59 p.m. three days before arrival; verify the hotel's time zone and exact date on the booking screen. Confirm the room description includes a desk and retain the hotel's confirmation that Wednesday luggage storage is complimentary.
